duplicate_verdict: The 2019 / Journal of Applied Econometrics 34(5) / pp. 661-672 coordinates (this entry, 'alessi') are the real, verified published article, confirmed via Crossref for DOI 10.1002/jae.2706, SSRN (abstract_id=2854133), and the ECB Working Paper Series No. 1967 precursor. The competing coordinates in the sibling entry 'alessi2016response' (2016 / 31(6) / 930-950) do not belong to any real article: the actual contents of JAE vol. 31 no. 6 (Sept/Oct 2016) run pages 929-1196 with no Alessi or Kerssenfischer paper anywhere in the issue (confirmed against the full table of contents at ftp.math.utah.edu's JAE bibliography) — the nearest page range, 929-960, belongs to Bailey, Kapetanios & Pesaran's 'Exponent of Cross-Sectional Dependence: Estimation and Inference', an unrelated econometric-theory paper with no author overlap. '31(6) 930-950 (2016)' is therefore a fabricated/hallucinated citation, not a mislabeled but genuine second paper; 'alessi2016response' is a corrupted duplicate of this entry and should be deleted (or all \cite{alessi2016response} calls redirected to \cite{alessi}).
